title: AI across the lifecycle — a worked episode

segments.speaker: host
segments.text: Welcome back to the show, thanks to our sponsor, and don't forget to like and subscribe. Today we have a great guest and a fun chat ahead, grab a coffee and settle in.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: On agentic coding we ran a benchmark across 4 enterprise repos and measured the failure modes of autonomous edit-run-test loops. The cost model matters: token spend per developer rose 30 percent, so we added autonomy controls and a budget guardrail in the agentic IDE workspace to keep code generation bounded.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: For the outer loop we built an AI code review pattern wired into the CI pipeline, plus AI assisted testing and QA before release. The evidence over 6 weeks showed the review and test stages catching regressions earlier in continuous integration and deployment.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: We moved product discovery toward spec-driven development. The requirements are captured as an ontology so the roadmap and design flow from a shared specification. Across 3 teams the spec-driven product development lifecycle reduced rework in discovery.

segments.speaker: host
segments.text: Anyway, totally off topic, but the weather has been wild lately and I finally tried that new ramen place downtown. Ten out of ten, would recommend the spicy bowl.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: On measurement we designed a delivery scorecard with metrics tying AI usage to throughput, quality and speed, with evidence on business outcomes. One metric tracked merged change throughput up 18 percent against a baseline cohort.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: Governance needs real guardrails. We defined an evaluation gate and risk controls for autonomous agents in the delivery lifecycle, with a policy and assurance pattern that blocks an agent action until the eval passes. This is a concrete control, not ethics commentary.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: Under payments constraints we handle AI under PCI and tokenization rules. Cardholder data never reaches the model; a redaction pass strips bank details and PII before any prompt leaves the regulated environment, a data-handling pattern specific to payments.

segments.speaker: host
segments.text: Quick reminder to check out our merch store and join the listener community, we love the support, it really helps the show keep going.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: On the vendor landscape a new model dropped with a pricing shift that changes the build versus buy calculus for our platform decisions. The capability jump in long context could move several workloads from a custom stack to a vendor model.
